Bash(pnpm --filter @mcp-market/api exec vitest run src/routes/__tests__/dashboard.test.ts src/routes/__tests__/submissions.test.ts src/routes/__tests__/marketplace.test.ts src/routes/__tests__/gateway.test.ts src/routes/__tests__/admin.test.ts src/services/__tests__/revenue.test.ts)

hooks.command: CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command') && if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\b.*\b(commit|push)\b'; then GIT_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$GIT_ROOT" ] && [ -d "$GIT_ROOT/src" ]; then if grep -rn 'console\.log' "$GIT_ROOT/src" --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --exclude-dir=node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5 | grep -q .; then echo '[Guard] console.log가 남아있습니다 — 제거 후 커밋하세요' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' && { grep -n 'console\.log' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo '[Hook] console.log 발견 — 커밋 전 제거 필요' >&2; if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then TSC=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -A1 "$FILE" | head -5); [ -n "$TSC" ] && echo "[Hook] 타입 에러: $TSC" >&2; fi; } || true

CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | head -20) && [ -n "$CHANGED" ] && { LOGS=$(echo "$CHANGED" | xargs grep -ln 'console\.log' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$LOGS" ] && echo "[Stop] console.log 잔류 파일: $LOGS" >&2; if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then ERRS=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -3); echo "$ERRS" | grep -q 'error' && echo "[Stop] 타입 에러 있음: $ERRS" >&2; fi; } || true; exit 0
